mapper.sql: select p.person_id, p.person_code, p.person_name, p.dept_id, d.dept_name, p.position_name, p.email, p.mobile, p.status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from pm_person p left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id
mapper.select:
and p.person_code like concat('%', #{personCode}, '%') and p.person_name like concat('%', #{personName}, '%') and (p.dept_id = #{deptId} or p.dept_id in ( select dept_id from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors))) and p.position_name like concat('%', #{positionName}, '%') and p.status = #{status}
order by p.person_id desc

where p.status = '0'
and (p.person_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.person_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.dept_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by p.person_name, p.person_id limit 100
mapper.insert: insert into pm_person(person_code, person_name, dept_id, position_name, email, mobile, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{personCode}, #{personName}, #{deptId}, #{positionName}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from pm_person where person_id in #{personId}
